name: understanding-graph
description: Develop persistent, fluid understanding through a local graph.

interface.shortDescription: Let persistent structure change the next thought.
interface.longDescription: Understanding Graph gives an agent a local, revisable medium in which research, writing, coding, decisions, and other substantive work can develop. The bundled skill teaches the agent to preserve communicable, material understanding that could matter to the work or a future inquiry, ask the graph for weighted concrete provocations, freely choose a route, and let accumulated structure produce later insight.
defaultPrompt: Help me investigate this question through the graph
Read this source chronologically through the graph
Develop this draft through repeated graph re-entry
Build this software in graph-native units
